subject: Animation
title: The Streaming Animation Boom
description: A fast breakdown of The Streaming Animation Boom for builders.

hook.text: Netflix, Amazon, Apple, and Disney+ are all investing heavily in original animated series for adults.

buildup.text: Animation costs less than live-action, scales globally without dubbing issues, and ages better visually.

discovery.text: Streaming data showed that animated shows have longer shelf lives — viewers discover them years after release.

twist.text: Despite the boom, many shows are canceled after one season as platforms chase quick hits over slow builds.

climax.text: The streaming era has created more animated content than ever, but sustaining shows remains a challenge.

punchline.text: More animated shows exist than ever, but fewer get to finish.

quiz.question: Why are streaming platforms investing heavily in animation?
options: Animation costs less, scales globally, and data shows animated shows have longer viewer shelf lives
Animation is easier to produce than live-action
